spec.title: Subsystem inventory
spec.description: Every (system, subsystem) tuple seen in range. Surfaces newly-shipped and silently-dropped subsystems.

query.expr: sum by (system, subsystem) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="" | system!="" [$__range]))

spec.title: Top error messages
spec.description: Most frequent warn/error events. Top of this list is where to spend the next round of fixes.

query.expr: topk(20, sum by (event, system, subsystem) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="" | level=~"warning|error" [$__range])))

spec.title: Log rate by system
spec.description: Total log rate aggregated by system.

query.expr: sum by (system) (rate({service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="" | system!="" [$__interval]))

spec.title: Warn + error rate by system
spec.description: Warn + error rate aggregated by system. First place to look during an incident.

query.expr: sum by (system) (rate({service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="" | system!="" | level=~"warning|error" [$__interval]))

spec.title: avatars — log rate by subsystem
spec.description: Log rate within avatars, grouped by subsystem.

query.expr: sum by (subsystem) (rate({service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="" | system="avatars" | subsystem!="" [$__interval]))

spec.title: avatars — warn + error rate by subsystem
spec.description: Warn + error rate within avatars, grouped by subsystem.

spec.title: avatars — recent logs
spec.description: Live tail filtered to system=avatars. Respects the global subsystem and level filters.

query.expr: {service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="" | system="avatars" | subsystem=~"$subsystem" | level=~"$level"

spec.title: Lines that broke `| json` (jsonparsererr)
spec.description: Log lines that Loki's `| json` parser rejects. Source labels (code_file_path, code_function_name, code_line_number) tell you which Python file is emitting broken JSON — usually an f-string containing a stray `{` like a dict literal or repr() output. Fix at source by switching the call to structlog kwargs.

query.expr: {service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="jsonparsererr"

spec.title: Top sources of broken JSON
spec.description: Which source files are emitting broken JSON, ranked by count. Fix the top entries at source.

query.expr: topk(20, sum by (code_file_path, code_function_name, code_line_number) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment="$env"} | json | __error__="jsonparsererr" [$__range])))

spec.name: subsystem
spec.label: Subsystem
spec.description: Regex filter applied to recent-logs panels. Empty matches all.

DraftForge structured-log dashboard. Overview row at the top summarizes inventory, log rate, warn/error rate, and top error events. Each system in the canonical taxonomy gets its own collapsed row below — expand the one you care about. Bottom row surfaces lines that fail `| json` parsing so we can fix them at source. See .claude/skills/logging/SKILL.md for the taxonomy.
